description: This Java interface defines methods for managing MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries in a logger, specifically for adding and removing context entries for logging purposes.

classes.name: WithMdcEntry
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods to add and remove MDC entries in a logger, parameterized by the logger type.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds a single MDC entry with a key and an optional value to the logger.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds two MDC entries with specified keys and optional values to the logger.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds three MDC entries with specified keys and optional values to the logger.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries provided as MdcEntry objects to the logger.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry identified by the specified key from the logger.
